mapper.insert: INSERT INTO chat_history ( chat_room_id, send_user_id, message, send_date ) VALUES ( #{chatRoomId}, #{userId}, #{message}, NOW() );
mapper.select: SELECT chat_history_id, chat_room_id, u.user_id, email, nickname, ch.send_date, message, profile_url, CASE WHEN TIMESTAMPDIFF(SECOND, ch.send_date, NOW()) < 60 THEN CONCAT(TIMESTAMPDIFF(SECOND, ch.send_date, NOW()), '초 전') WHEN TIMESTAMPDIFF(MINUTE, ch.send_date, NOW()) < 60 THEN CONCAT(TIMESTAMPDIFF(MINUTE, ch.send_date, NOW()), '분 전') WHEN TIMESTAMPDIFF(HOUR, ch.send_date, NOW()) < 24 THEN CONCAT(TIMESTAMPDIFF(HOUR, ch.send_date, NOW()), '시간 전') ELSE CONCAT(TIMESTAMPDIFF(DAY, ch.send_date, NOW()), '일 전') END AS time_ago FROM chat_history ch JOIN user u ON u.user_id = ch.send_user_id WHERE chat_room_id = #{chatRoomId} ORDER BY send_date DESC
mapper.update: UPDATE chat_room SET last_at = NOW() WHERE chat_room_id = #{chatRoomId};
